title: quercus ilex var. vulgaris
intro: Quercus ilex var. vulgaris, commonly known as Holm Oak or Ballota, is a variety of the holm oak tree that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The health benefits of Quercus ilex var. vulgaris are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
